looks.caption: decision.wait at 1.0 s: the wait panel with larger labels, the counter reads 6-8 business months, the cursor paces under it
decision.letter at 3.8 s: the letter is down, the metrics panel reads 00:00, the stamp block flies in over the cursor that reads the letter
decision.metrics at 7.2 s, the key moment: REJECTED on the letter, the cursor flat beside the mark, readouts counted, stamp at rest, button and link up
decision.metrics at 9.36 s: the cursor, whole again, presses Accept Rejection at its right end, clear of the label
